title: DEFINE step 3 PR 7: probeRunner seam, parseLitmusFlag and countLitmusReadersAtHash
description: src/query/readiness.js accepts an injectable `probeRunner` ({ reqId, tree }) => findings[], default null; when set, computeReadiness calls it once per REQ in scope and merges the returned findings into ledgers.probes.probes[] as open probe entries so consistency:probeCount reports them. With no runner the result equals the 0.29.0 result on the same fixture (AC-17504-2). Also exports parseLitmusFlag (positive-integer validator) and countLitmusReadersAtHash (reads distinct <reader> ids from probe-ledger entries whose finding begins litmus:<reader>: and whose text includes the given hash). Pure.
